```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(gopheR)
library(knitr)
library(reactable)

# Set database path
db_path <- normalizePath(file.path("..", "extdata"))
options(gopheR.db_path = db_path)
options(gopheR.db_file = "gopherDen_db.sqlite")
```

## Sample Overview

This page shows all environmental samples in the database and their associated metadata.

```{r sample-data}
# Get all samples
samples <- gopheR::with_gopher_con(function(con) {
  DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "
    SELECT
      o.object_id,
      o.object_subtype,
      o.label,
      o.description,
      o.created_at
    FROM object o
    WHERE o.object_type = 'sample'
    ORDER BY o.object_id
  ")
})

# Get site information for each sample via edges
sample_sites <- gopheR::with_gopher_con(function(con) {
  DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "
    SELECT
      e.child_id as sample_id,
      e.parent_id as site_id,
      s.label as site_label
    FROM edge e
    JOIN object s ON s.object_id = e.parent_id
    WHERE e.edge_type = 'part_of'
      AND e.parent_id LIKE 'site_%'
      AND e.child_id LIKE 'sample_%'
  ")
})

# Get any result data for samples
sample_results <- gopheR::with_gopher_con(function(con) {
  DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "
    SELECT
      r.object_id as sample_id,
      r.key,
      r.value
    FROM result r
    WHERE r.object_id LIKE 'sample_%'
  ")
})

# Join samples with sites
samples_full <- samples |>
  left_join(sample_sites, by = c("object_id" = "sample_id"))

# Pivot result data if available
if (nrow(sample_results) > 0) {
  sample_results_wide <- sample_results |>
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = key,
      values_from = value,
      values_fn = first
    )

  samples_full <- samples_full |>
    left_join(sample_results_wide, by = c("object_id" = "sample_id"))
}
```

## Sample Table

```{r sample-table}
reactable(
  samples_full,
  searchable = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  striped = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 20,
  columns = list(
    object_id = colDef(name = "Sample ID", minWidth = 120),
    object_subtype = colDef(name = "Type", minWidth = 100),
    label = colDef(name = "Label", minWidth = 150),
    description = colDef(name = "Description", minWidth = 250),
    site_id = colDef(name = "Site ID", minWidth = 100),
    site_label = colDef(name = "Site", minWidth = 150),
    created_at = colDef(name = "Created", minWidth = 180)
  )
)
```

## Sample Provenance

This section shows how samples connect to other objects in the database.

```{r sample-connections}
# Get readsets from samples
sample_readsets <- gopheR::with_gopher_con(function(con) {
  DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "
    SELECT
      e.parent_id as sample_id,
      COUNT(DISTINCT e.child_id) as n_readsets
    FROM edge e
    WHERE e.edge_type = 'sequenced_from'
      AND e.parent_id LIKE 'sample_%'
    GROUP BY e.parent_id
  ")
})

# Get MAGs observed in samples (via readsets)
sample_mags <- gopheR::with_gopher_con(function(con) {
  DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "
    SELECT
      rs.parent_id as sample_id,
      COUNT(DISTINCT obs.child_id) as n_mags_observed
    FROM edge rs
    JOIN edge obs ON obs.parent_id = rs.child_id
    WHERE rs.edge_type = 'sequenced_from'
      AND rs.parent_id LIKE 'sample_%'
      AND obs.edge_type = 'observed_in'
      AND obs.child_id LIKE 'MAG%'
    GROUP BY rs.parent_id
  ")
})

# Combine
sample_summary <- samples |>
  left_join(sample_sites, by = c("object_id" = "sample_id")) |>
  left_join(sample_readsets, by = c("object_id" = "sample_id")) |>
  left_join(sample_mags, by = c("object_id" = "sample_id")) |>
  replace_na(list(n_readsets = 0, n_mags_observed = 0)) |>
  select(object_id, label, site_label, n_readsets, n_mags_observed)

kable(sample_summary,
      col.names = c("Sample ID", "Label", "Site", "Readsets", "MAGs Observed"),
      caption = "Sample connections to other objects")
```

## Samples by Site

```{r samples-by-site}
samples_full |>
  count(site_label) |>
  filter(!is.na(site_label)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(site_label, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2c7fb8", alpha = 0.8) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Samples per Site",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of Samples"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))
```

## Sample Types

```{r sample-types}
samples |>
```
